contests.title: Leicester — Question 10: High School campus debt exclusion

provenance.quote: Shall the Town of Leicester be allowed to exempt from the provisions of proposition two and one-half, so-called, the amounts required to pay for the bonds issued in order to fund the costs of upgrades, modernization and repairs, and further, to create and furnish additional space to allow for the inclusion and/or expansion of vocational education programs to the properties known as the Campus Center Building (964 Main Street), the Borger Building (9 Washburn Square), Swan Library (13 Washburn Square), the Animal Health Center (955 Main Street), and associated grounds, all properties determined as the Leicester High School Campus, including the payment of all other costs incidental and related thereto?

measures.questionText: Shall the City of Haverhill allow the sale of marijuana and marijuana products, as those terms are defined in section 1 of chapter 94G of the General Laws, for consumption on the premises where sold, a summary of which appears below?
measures.officialStatement: Section 3(b)(2) of Chapter 94G of the General Laws of Massachusetts establishes a process for petitioning a city to allow on-site consumption of marijuana within the limits of the City. Upon certification of the petition, the City must place the question on the ballot for the next regularly occurring municipal or state election in the form prescribed by the statute. The above question, if voted in the affirmative, would allow consumption of marijuana and marijuana products on the premises where sold, subject to the reasonable limitations established by the City.

provenance.quote: Shall the City of Haverhill allow the sale of marijuana and marijuana products, as those terms are defined in section 1 of chapter 94G of the General Laws, for consumption on the premises where sold, a summary of which appears below?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allows Leicester to collect property taxes above Proposition 2½’s normal limits for the amounts needed to pay bonds for upgrades, modernization and repairs, and to create and furnish space for new or expanded vocational education programs at the Leicester High School campus. The covered properties are the Campus Center Building at 964 Main Street, Borger Building at 9 Washburn Square, Swan Library at 13 Washburn Square, Animal Health Center at 955 Main Street, and their grounds, including related costs. The exclusion applies to the bond payments for this work.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the property-tax debt exclusion for these campus and vocational-space bond payments.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject the proposed debt exclusion for these project bond payments.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allows the sale of marijuana and marijuana products, as defined in Massachusetts law, for consumption on the premises where they are sold in Haverhill. The official summary says this permission would be subject to reasonable limits established by the city.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Allow marijuana and marijuana products to be sold for consumption on the same premises, subject to reasonable city limits.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed local permission for consumption on the premises where the products are sold.
